sessions.title: Sessions
chat.label: Chat
chat.placeholder: Ask Agentic Android to do something...
chat.key_warning: API key not set for selected provider.
chat.welcome_desc: Describe what you want done on your device, or interact with the live screen on the right.
chat.add_api_key_title: Configure API key to fetch live models
settings.title: Settings
keys.desc: Manage API keys for AI providers. Switch provider and model per session directly from the prompt box.
keys.empty: No provider API keys added yet. Select a provider below to add one.
models.desc: Choose the default provider and model used when creating new sessions, along with agent execution settings.
models.include_screenshot: Send live device screenshot with each agent step
models.notify_complete: Send notification when agent execution completes
prompt.desc: Customize the system instructions given to the AI agent before it controls your Android device.
prompt.label: System Prompt
memory.desc: Remember which app to use for what, plus per-app UI quirks. App purposes are shared on every turn; detailed UI notes are injected automatically when using that app.
memory.empty: No app playbooks saved yet. The agent will record UI quirks automatically, or you can add one below.
memory.label: App Label (optional)
memory.purpose_placeholder: e.g. German train connections, schedules, and tickets
memory.notes: UI Notes & Quirks (one per line, optional)
memory.notes_placeholder:
Tap 'Search' button before typing destination
Dismiss cookie banner via 'Accept all'
credentials.desc: Store app or website credentials locally on your device. Only labels and targets are listed to the agent; passwords are fetched on demand and redacted from chat logs.
credentials.empty: No credentials saved yet. Click + New to add app or website logins for the agent.
credentials.label: Name / Label
credentials.notes_placeholder: e.g. Use 'Sign in with email' tab, not passkey
telegram.title: Telegram Remote Control
telegram.desc: Control this Android device from anywhere using a Telegram bot (create one with @BotFather).
telegram.enable: Enable Telegram Bot (long-polling, no port forwarding needed)
telegram.allowed_ids_hint: Message /id to your bot on Telegram to discover your Chat ID. Only listed IDs can control your device.
security.login_desc: Optionally require a username and password to access the Web UI.
security.mfa_desc: Use any TOTP authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, Bitwarden, Apple Passwords).
security.mfa_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key manually:
login.title: Sign in to Agentic Android
login.desc: Enter your credentials to access this device.
uitree.title: Accessibility UI Tree
apk.title: Sideload APK / XAPK
apk.desc: Upload an Android .apk or .xapk file to sideload onto the device. The Android installer prompt will appear on the Live Screen.
apk.drop_hint: Drop .apk / .xapk file here or click to browse
apk.invalid_file: Please select a valid .apk, .xapk, .apks, or .apkm file.
apk.launched: Installer opened on device — tap Install on the Live Screen.
apk.needs_permission: Enable 'Allow from this source' on the Live Screen, then upload again.
apk.upload_failed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
emulator.switch_desc: Select an installed Android Virtual Device and restart the emulator with it.
emulator.create_desc: Download a system image via sdkmanager and create a new AVD (non-Play Store google_apis images are recommended).
emulator.switch_after: Switch to the new AVD and restart automatically
